title: Electrical Stimulation of Nerve Roots and Colonic Motility in Anesthetized Pigs
author: Muriel Larauche

steps.title: Preoperative Preparation
steps.instruction: Fast Yucatan minipigs (6-7 months old, 25-36 kg) for at least 12h prior to surgery with free access to water.

steps.title: Induce Anesthesia and Stabilization
steps.instruction: Administer premedication and maintain general anesthesia and ventilation.

substeps.instruction: Inject midazolam (1 mg/kg), ketamine (15 mg/kg), and meloxicam (0.3 mg/kg) intramuscularly.
Intubate and connect to a respirator (breathing rate 13-16 breaths/min).
Maintain anesthesia with 1-3% inhaled isoflurane.
Administer maintenance fluids (lactated ringers) at 10 ml/kg/h.
Position pig in supine position on a heating pad (32°C).
Place a femoral artery line, flushing with sterile saline containing 0.5% heparin when needed.

steps.title: Insert Colonic Manometry Probes
steps.instruction: Perform a midline abdominal incision to access the peritoneum and insert manometry probes (Mikro-Cath™ #825-0101) into three colonic regions, securing them with loophole silk ligatures.

substeps.instruction: Proximal colon: Insert 4 probes about 10 cm below the ceco-colic junction, at 10, 13, 16, and 19 cm from the point of entry.
Transverse colon: Insert 4 probes at the end of the proximal colon, at 10, 13, 16, and 19 cm from the point of entry.
Distal colon: Insert probes through the anus with sensors at 10, 13, 16, and 19 cm proximal to the anal verge, plus one sensor in the anal canal (2 cm from the anal verge).

steps.title: Perform Laminectomy
steps.instruction: Access the S1-S4 sacral spinal nerves or T12-L1 thoracolumbar spinal nerves via laminectomy (approx. 30-40 min).

substeps.instruction: Place pig in prone position and identify vertebral levels (T12-L1 or S1-S4) via palpation.
Perform midline incision and dissect subcutaneous tissue/fat to expose thoracolumbar or lumbosacral fascia.
Cut fascia and open supraspinous ligaments over a few millimeters.
Use a Freer elevator to detach supraspinous ligaments from spinous processes via subperiosteal dissection, extending to interspinous ligaments and facet joints.
Open the lamina using a surgical saw or Kerrison rongeur to expose the ligamentum flavum, periosteum, epidural fat, and dura sac.
Remove corresponding spinous processes and gently remove epidural fat to identify spinal roots.
Perform hemostasis using bipolar electrosurgery (avoid monopolar), bone wax for bone bleeding, and absorbable hemostat dressing (Surgicel®) for soft tissue.

steps.title: Place Stimulation Electrodes
steps.instruction: Identify and isolate the left thoracolumbar (T12-L1) and sacral root nerves (S1, S2, S3, S4) using small pieces of cotton, then place needle or cuff electrodes (NCX-2.5-3-500umPR-1-1-500SS-SUT).

steps.title: Setup Data Acquisition
steps.instruction: Connect manometry probes to the recording system.

substeps.instruction: Connect Mikro-Cath™ probes via PEC-10D pressure cables to a PCU-2000 transducer.
Connect transducer to a Micro 1401 data acquisition system.
Collect raw data using Spike 2 software.

steps.title: Perform Electrical Stimulation
steps.instruction: Establish a baseline for at least 30 min, then initiate stimulation for 10 min according to the specific nerve target.

substeps.instruction: Thoracolumbar Nerve Stimulation (TLNS): Stimulate T12 and L1 roots (left side) using a needle electrode. Use either 10 Hz, 0.3 ms, 0.5 mA, continuous (30s on, 90s off) OR 30 Hz, 0.3 ms, 0.5 mA, pulse-train (30s on, 90s off).

Sacral Nerve Stimulation (SNS): Stimulate S1, S2, S3, and S4 roots (left side) using a cuff electrode. Use 30 Hz, 0.3 ms, 0.5 mA, pulse-train (30s on, 90s off), with or without afferent (AB) or efferent (EB) block (40 kHz, 0.1 ms, 2 mA).

steps.title: Post-Stimulation Recording and Euthanasia
steps.instruction: Continue recording motility for at least 30 minutes following the completion of stimulation, then euthanize the animal.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize pig via intravenous injection of pentobarbital (100 mg/kg).

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the 30 min pre-stimulation and 40 min post-onset (10 min during, 30 min after) recording periods.

substeps.instruction: Filter and rectify raw manometry data using Spike 2 code.
Calculate the Motility Index (MI) as the area under the curve per minute.
